summary: A lightbox opened from a button to show a single generated SVG image.
use: Enlarging one thumbnail or photo to full view on click.
spec: `<Lightbox bind:open src={photo} alt="Gray circle on a dark background" />`
`photo` is a `data:image/svg+xml;utf8,` URL built with `encodeURIComponent`, 640 by 400 with a circle `r="90"`
Trigger is `<Button variant="outlined" onclick={() => (open = true)}>` labelled View photo
